relationships.subject: ACY-1083
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of ACY-1083 significantly increased Il10 mRNA levels in the spinal cord of cisplatin-treated mice

relationships.subject: MRC1+ macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: Depletion of spinal cord MRC1 (CD206) positive macrophages by intrathecal administration of mannosylated clodronate liposomes prevented the increase in spinal cord Il10 mRNA in response to HDAC6 inhibitor treatment

relationships.subject: ACY-1083
relationships.evidence_quote: Both HDAC6 inhibitors reversed cisplatin-induced mechanical hypersensitivity in females

relationships.subject: IL-10
relationships.evidence_quote: critical role of IL-10 signaling to IL-10 receptors on Advillin+ sensory neurons in the resolution of cisplatin-induced mechanical hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: anti-IL-10 antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: co-administration of anti-IL-10 antibody prevented the reversal of mechanical hypersensitivity in response to the HDAC6 inhibitor in both male and female mice

key_findings: HDAC6 inhibitor reverses cisplatin mechanical hypersensitivity via spinal MRC1+ macrophage IL-10 signaling to IL-10 receptors on Advillin+ sensory neurons.
HDAC6 inhibitor normalizes tibial nerve mitochondrial function independently of macrophages and IL-10.
